_note: Assumptions for the Gale data-center site study. Every value here is a scenario assumption, not data. Edit freely; then run python -m martian_map snapshot.
name: Gale crater data-center site study

base.note: assumption: Curiosity's landing spot (Bradbury Landing), inside a landing area NASA already judged safe. Placeholder until the team decides.

trip_area.note: assumption: 3.6 x 4.3 km box around the base and both near-base sites with a margin of about 110-160 m, for planning walking and rover routes between them (2 m elevation and slope). Added 2026-11-15 for the route planner.

sites.name: Curiosity recent path (boxwork area)
sites.note: assumption: kept as the hard contrast: 10-13 km from the base and mostly too steep (44% of 10 m boxes within the 10 degree BT-05 limit).

sites.name: Near base, north (crater floor)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-14 by screening the 10 m slope map for flat, dune-free crater floor within about 1-3 km of the base (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 2.5 km); 89% of 10 m cells at or under 5 degrees.

sites.name: Near base, west (crater floor, on Curiosity's early path)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-14 the same way (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 2.9 km); dune-free, and about 1.8 km of Curiosity's 2013 drive crosses it, so part of it was checked on the ground.

facility_footprint_m.note: not agreed; 200 x 200 m = 4 ha, the top of the 2-4 ha precinct search envelope in docs/reference-facility.md

max_construction_slope_deg.note: overall pad tilt; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_local_pad_slope_deg.note: steepest 10 m x 10 m window on the pad; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_roughness_m.note: placeholder only: BT-08 has no universal limit; it must come from the support design (R_allow)

vehicle_step_limit_m.note: illustration only in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md; not an adopted rover capability

dem_vertical_precision_m.note: used for noise floors only if no primary source gives the Gale 1 m DEM's precision

reference_facility.note: copied from docs/reference-facility.md (proposals, not engineering values)
